covers: JSE session and overnight markets to about 13:10 SAST on Thursday 12 November 2026
headline: Breaking: Nvidia down more than 6% before the US open on a report that its board is preparing to remove Jensen Huang; the JSE holds small gains
summary: The JSE gave back part of its midday gain: at 13:09 SAST the All Share was at 113,730.05 (+0.2%) and the Top 40 at 105,752.22 (+0.2%), with banks still higher but off their best — Nedbank +1.6%, Standard Bank +1.4% — and gold miners lower (LRC Market Dashboard and LRC Stock Scanner (Yahoo Finance), 12 Nov 2026). In the US, a MarketWatch headline at 12:07 SAST says Nvidia's board reportedly prepares to remove CEO Jensen Huang, and a CNBC headline at 13:02 SAST says the stock is down more than 6% before the open (headlines, 12 Nov 2026; we could not open the articles). The rand was at R16.62/$ and gold at $3,959.00, still below $4,000, as the dollar stays firm on Fed rate-hike bets (LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 12 Nov 2026 13:09 SAST).

items.title: Nvidia board reportedly preparing to remove CEO Jensen Huang; shares down more than 6% pre-market
items.summary: A MarketWatch headline published at 12:07 SAST says Nvidia's stock is dropping as the board reportedly prepares to remove CEO Jensen Huang. A CNBC headline updated at 13:02 SAST says the stock is down more than 6% as investors await his fate, and a separate MarketWatch headline at 12:57 SAST says Megaspeed, the company at the centre of the scandal, has issued a statement. We could not open these articles, so we cannot confirm who first reported the board's plans, the pre-market price, or any company statement. Nvidia last closed at $173.73 (+2.9%) on 11 Nov.
items.source: MarketWatch headlines, 12 Nov 2026 12:07 and 12:57 SAST; CNBC headline, 12 Nov 2026 13:02 SAST; LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance), 11 Nov 2026 close

items.title: Nasdaq-100 futures slide as the Nvidia sell-off resumes
items.summary: CNBC's live-updates headline, refreshed at 12:27 SAST, says Nasdaq-100 futures are sliding as the Nvidia sell-off resumes. We could not open the page for futures levels. Wall Street opens at 16:30 SAST.

items.title: Oil lower on peace-talk hopes and rising supply; copper about $13,741/t
items.summary: Moneyweb and Investing.com headlines say oil fell toward a two-month low on hopes for Iran and Ukraine peace talks and rising Middle East production; a separate headline says the US Energy Information Administration raised its 2026 crude price forecasts. Our price feeds give conflicting Brent readings this morning, so we leave out a level until we can confirm it. Copper was at about $13,741 a tonne.
